mentions.name: Pagenerd
mentions.description: Pagenerd is a podcast about science fiction, loosely defined, created by the hosts as a way to talk about the genre and hang out together.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started Pagenerd with some friends to talk about science fiction - loosely defined - and give us a chance to hang out.  It’s pretty good. Find it at https://pagenerd.com which links to all the usual places.
